dish: Curry soba and Okinawa soba on house-made noodles in a Rausu-kombu and Makurazaki-bonito broth
n: Jikasei-men Okinawa Soba Miyoya, Kadena (自家製麺 沖縄そば みよ家)
w: An Okinawa-soba specialist in Kadena making its own noodles and an additive-free broth from Rausu kombu and Makurazaki bonito; its curry soba is a signature. OTV Okitive ranked it No. 3 in its 2025 island-wide 'must-eat' Okinawa soba 15.

dish: IFFA gold-medal handmade German-method sausages and ham; weekend-only hot dogs
w: A ham-and-sausage maker on Koza's Gate Street, opened April 2017 by an Okinawan trained in German charcuterie methods; its products have won gold medals at IFFA, the German international meat-processing competition. Sausages are made by hand daily and a weekend hot-dog counter serves them in-shop.
